name: sales-confirmation
title: Draft sales order confirmation
for_each: select id,code from orders where kind='sales' and status<>'cancelled'

sections.title: Order details
sections.note: Draft only. Amounts exclude tax. Review before issue.
sections.sql: select code,partner,location,status,due_date::text,total,(select currency from settings limit 1) as currency from v_orders where id=$1

sections.title: Order lines
sections.sql: select i.code,i.name,i.unit,l.quantity,l.completed,l.unit_price,(l.quantity*l.unit_price)::numeric(14,2) as line_amount from order_lines l join items i on i.id=l.item_id where l.order_id=$1 order by l.line_no

name: purchase-order
title: Draft purchase order
for_each: select id,code from orders where kind='purchase' and status<>'cancelled'

sections.title: Order details
sections.note: Draft only. Amounts exclude tax. Review before issue.
sections.sql: select code,partner,location,status,due_date::text,total,(select currency from settings limit 1) as currency from v_orders where id=$1

sections.title: Budget and position
sections.note: Recorded job costs only. Order shipments are not automatically charged to jobs.
sections.sql: select code,name,customer,status,budget,cost,budget_left,revenue,margin,(select currency from settings limit 1) as currency from v_jobs where id=$1

sections.title: Costs recorded
sections.sql: select category,amount,note,created_at from job_costs where job_id=$1 order by created_at
